```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18, 12, 24),
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "itail": (60e-6, 40e-6, 90e-6),
    "nbud1": (6e-16, 3e-16, 1.0e-15),   # diff-pair 1/f noise budget [V^2/Hz]
    "nbud3": (5e-16, 2e-16, 9e-16),     # mirror 1/f noise budget [V^2/Hz]
    "gmidn": (6, 4, 9),
    "Lm":    (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "L6":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.2),
    "i2":    (160e-6, 100e-6, 250e-6),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "cc":    (4e-12, 2.5e-12, 7e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.5, 1.0, 3.0),
}

KN, KP = 7.8e-13, 2.6e-13
WMAX_TOT = 2500.0

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it, i2, cc = p["itail"], p["i2"], p["cc"]
    i1 = it / 2

    # PMOS diff pair: raise gm/Id at fixed L until W*L meets the 1/f budget
    wl1_t = 2 * KP / p["nbud1"]
    g = p["gmid1"]
    m1 = lut.size("p", g, p["L1"], i1, vds=0.7, vsb=0.3)
    while m1.W * m1.L < wl1_t and g < 26 and m1.W < WMAX_TOT:
        g += 0.5
        m1 = lut.size("p", g, p["L1"], i1, vds=0.7, vsb=0.3)
    gm1 = m1.gm

    # NMOS mirror load: lengthen L until W*L meets its budget
    L3 = p["Lm"]
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], L3, i1, vds=0.7)
    def wl3_t(m):
        return 2 * KN / p["nbud3"] * (m.gm / gm1) ** 2
    while m3.W * m3.L < wl3_t(m3) and L3 < 8.0 and m3.W < WMAX_TOT:
        L3 *= 1.15
        m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], L3, i1, vds=m3.vgs)

    # second stage NMOS CS: pick gm/Id so its Vgs matches the mirror Vgs
    best = None
    gg = 3.0
    while gg <= 20.0:
        cand = lut.size("n", gg, p["L6"], i2, vds=0.9)
        err = abs(cand.vgs - m3.vgs)
        if best is None or err < best[0]:
            best = (err, cand)
        gg += 0.5
    m6 = best[1]

    # PMOS bias mirrors (same gm/Id and L)
    gp = 10
    mpb = lut.size("p", gp, p["Lp"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("p", gp, p["Lp"], it, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("p", gp, p["Lp"], i2, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    mbn = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=1.0)

    rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb, m=1)
    n.dev("MBN", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbn, m=1)
    n.dev("MPB", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpb, m=1)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m5, m=1)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m7, m=1)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vdd", m1, m=1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vdd", m1, m=1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3, m=1)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3, m=1)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "out1", "vss", "vss", m6, m=1)
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m1.cgd
    co = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * cc + c1 * co + cc * co))
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1)
    cm = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m1.cgd + m3.cdd
    fmirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cm)
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * (rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)) if rz > 1.0 / m6.gm else 1e30
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fmirror)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(2 * PI * gbw / wz)) - 5.0
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    sv2 = 2 * (8.0 / 3.0) * kT / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    sv_f = 2 * KP / max(m1.W * m1.L, 1e-3) \
         + 2 * KN / max(m3.W * m3.L, 1e-3) * (m3.gm / gm1) ** 2
    noise = math.sqrt(sv2 + sv_f)
    power = vdd * (2 * iref + it + i2)
    slew = min(it / cc, i2 / (cc + cl))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise, "slew": slew}
```
